title: Better to be wanted by the police than not to be wanted at all (attacks against public figures)
heading: Better to be wanted by the police than not to be wanted at all (attacks against public figures)

notes.coreMechanism: visibility motives and grievance can shape attacks against public figures, so repeated public-facing approach behavior and access-oriented signaling deserve a hard read even when the conduct looks theatrical
notes.mainLimit: do not flatten all attention-seeking actors into one attack forecast, but do not let spectacle or fame myths erase repeated approach patterns
